manifest.name: dsh-context-lens
manifest.description: Inspect, measure, search, and compare the exact provider-neutral context assembled by DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:packaging && pnpm run package:check

bundle.text:
# Installable DeepSeek Harness bundle layer. The package name is intentionally
# bare: profile installs resolve it from the profile dependency graph.
- insert:
    - id: context-lens
      name: dsh-context-lens

config.name: persistMetadata
config.description: Write metadata-only sidecars; false keeps captures process-local.

config.name: maxAttemptsPerSession
config.description: Retained metadata attempts per session; older entries are dropped.

config.name: charsPerEstimatedToken
config.description: Fixed-density token estimate denominator; estimates are labelled as such.

readme.text:
简体中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

`dsh-context-lens` 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的上下文观测插件。它记录每次 AgentLoop 调用模型时组装出的 provider-neutral 请求，并在会话里增加一个 **上下文** 页签。

用它可以看清这次请求带了哪些 system prompt、messages 和 tools，各部分占了多少空间，以及它和上一次 attempt 有什么不同。

Context Lens 只读观察 Harness 的公开运行时接缝。它不会修改发给 LLM 的请求，也不会注册模型可调用工具。

- 每个 turn / step / attempt 的 provider、model、system、messages、tools 和调用配置。
- 能严格对应到最终 system prompt 的命名 section。无法确定来源的内容会标为“未归因”，不做猜测。
- Harness Session 中已记录的 skill、`AGENTS.md`、插件 context 和 session reference 等来源信息。
- 精确的 UTF-8 字节、UTF-16 code unit、Unicode code point 和逻辑 JSON 字节。
- 明确标为估算的 token 数，不冒充 provider tokenizer 的精确结果。
- 搜索、原始/结构化查看、attempt 对比和诊断 JSON 导出。

> 这里的请求是进入 Harness `llm/stream` 调度接缝的 provider-neutral `GenerateOptions`。Provider adapter 仍可以在后面将它转换为厂商自己的 HTTP payload。本插件不抓取网络报文。

| 项目 | 已验证版本 |
| --- | --- |
| Context Lens | `0.1.0` |
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.1.0-rc.5` |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24.0.0` |
| 界面 | `web` profile |

Harness 仍在 RC 阶段快速演进。本项目只对表中版本给出已验证承诺，不默认其他 RC 拥有相同的事件、client slot 和 bundle 契约。

从 GitHub Releases 下载 `dsh-context-lens-0.1.0.tgz`，然后执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-context-lens-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh web
```

如果你在 DeepSeek Harness 源码仓库中运行 CLI，在命令前加 `pnpm`：

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-context-lens-0.1.0.tgz
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
pnpm dsh web
```

`--dump-config` 的输出中应出现 `dsh-context-lens` bundle layer 和 `context-lens` row。

固定 tag 或 commit，不要跟随会移动的分支：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:OWNER/dsh-context-lens#v0.1.0
```

仓库会提交已构建的 `lib/`。pnpm 10+ 仍可能要求在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中允许 Git 依赖执行 `prepare`：

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-context-lens: true
```

只应对已审查且已固定的源码授权。不想允许安装时构建时，使用 release tarball。

1. 启动 `dsh web`。
2. 新建或打开一个会话，至少完成一次 agent turn。
3. 在 **Chat** / **Trajectory** 旁边打开 **上下文** / **Context**。
4. 从 attempt 列表选择一次请求，查看体积、来源、原始值和与上一次的差异。
5. 需要提交 bug 时，使用页面中的 JSON 导出。导出文件可能包含重建后的原始上下文，分享前请先审查。

Context Lens 不会为原始 prompt、message 或 tool schema 再建一份持久化副本。

- 原始请求只在实时采集路径中短暂存在。
- sidecar 写入 `$DSH_HOME/context-lens/v1`，只保存序号引用、测量值、span、时间、健康状态和 HMAC。
- 指纹使用每个安装独立的随机密钥计算 HMAC-SHA-256，不使用裸 SHA-256。
- 本地 API 只支持 `GET` / `HEAD`，检查 loopback 对端和 Host authority，并返回 `Cache-Control: no-store`。不要将它直接暴露到 LAN 或公网。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `persistMetadata` | `true` | 是否写入只含元数据的 sidecar |
| `maxAttemptsPerSession` | `500` | 每个 Session 最多保留的 attempt 索引 |
| `charsPerEstimatedToken` | `4` | 每个估算 token 对应的 UTF-16 code unit |

在更后面的 profile `cordis.patch.yml` layer 中覆盖完整 `config`：

```yaml
- id: context-lens
  config:
    persistMetadata: true
    maxAttemptsPerSession: 250

DSH patch 会替换这一 row 的整个 `config`，不会 deep merge。

1. 运行 `dsh --profile web --dump-config`，确认包含 `dsh-context-lens` 和 `context-lens`。
2. 重启 `dsh web`。
3. 对浏览器做一次强制刷新。

采集只从插件加载之后开始。重启 Web profile，再新建会话并发送一条消息。不含 prompt/message 内容的健康接口是：

```text
/context-lens/api/v1/health
```

`recordedAttempts` 应随真实 AgentLoop 请求增长。`ignoredLlmStreams` 计入标题生成和压缩等辅助调用，不是错误。

readme.section: 安装本地 tarball 失败
readme.text: 先将 tarball 放到不含空格的短路径，再将该路径传给 `dsh plugin add`。不要把 `link:` 开发 checkout 当成发布兼容证据；release 验收应使用打包后的 tarball。
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-context-lens-0.1.0.tgz

dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-context-lens
```

更新或卸载后重启 `dsh web`。Harness 不会在卸载时自动删除插件数据。如果也要删除 capture index 和 HMAC 密钥，先停止所有 Harness 进程，再只删除 `$DSH_HOME/context-lens/`。

Context Lens 在 `system-prompt/assemble` 前后读取命名 assembly，在 `agent/pre-step` 关联 step，在 `llm/stream` 读取最终 provider-neutral 请求。所有 waterfall listener 都会原样调用下游 `next()`。

真实 AgentLoop 请求优先通过 Harness 官方 `isAgentLoopRequest()` marker 识别。如果 Loader 模块边界拆分了这个进程内 WeakSet，结构证明只会接受同时满足以下条件的请求：

- 不带辅助调用 `purpose`。
- 除 `AbortSignal` 外的完整请求树已深冻结。
- 当前 Session 存在开放 step。
- 完整请求 envelope 与 `requestHeader()` 和 `deriveMessages()` 的结果严格相等。

标题生成、压缩和其他不匹配的 LLM stream 都会被忽略。每条 attempt 会记录它使用了 `marker` 还是 `session-structure` 证明。

插件不会向 Session 追加自定义 event。详细请求通过 Harness Session 和只含元数据的 sidecar 重建。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run verify
pnpm pack
```

`pnpm run verify` 会运行 lint、TypeScript 检查、全部测试、Host/Client 构建、打包契约检查和发布内容检查。发布前还应将 tarball 安装到真实 Harness `web` profile 做一次完整验收。

- [插件生命周期](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/index.zh.md)：Host 和 Client entry 导出 Cordis `apply`；必需 service 通过 `inject` 声明；注册随 Fiber 卸载。
- [插件配置](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/config.zh.md)：导出 Schemastery `Config`，非法值在加载时失败。
- [Bundle 发布](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.zh.md)：`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` 指向顶层 patch 数组，profile row 使用裸包名。
- [Client module table](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/client-modules.zh.md)：Web client 使用 lazy factory 注册，并从 Harness 模块表解析平台依赖。
- [工具开发](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/tool.zh.md)：本插件没有模型可调用工具，因此不使用 `defineTool`、tool schema 或 tool output rendering。
运行时声明以 `package.json#dsh.bundle`、`package.json#dsh.client` 和 `cordis.patch.yml` 为准。本包不提供官方 Loader 未定义的 `dsh.plugin.json`。
[MIT](./LICENSE)

[Simplified Chinese](./README.md) | English

`dsh-context-lens` is a context-observability plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It records the provider-neutral request assembled for each AgentLoop model call and adds a **Context** view to the conversation UI.

Use it to see which system prompt, messages, and tools were included in an attempt, how large each part was, and what changed since the previous attempt.
Context Lens observes public Harness runtime seams without changing the request passed to the LLM. It does not register a model-facing tool.

- Provider, model, system, messages, tools, and call configuration by turn, step, and attempt.
- Named system-prompt sections only when exact attribution is possible. Unmatched content stays explicitly unattributed.
- Durable provenance already present in Harness Session events, including skills, `AGENTS.md`, plugin context, and session references.
- Exact UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 code units, Unicode code points, and logical JSON bytes.
- Clearly labeled token estimates that are not presented as provider-tokenizer results.
- Search, raw and structured inspection, attempt comparison, and diagnostic JSON export.

> The inspected request is the provider-neutral `GenerateOptions` at Harness's `llm/stream` dispatch seam. A provider adapter may still transform it into its own HTTP payload. Context Lens does not capture network traffic.

| Component | Verified version |
| --- | --- |
| Context Lens | `0.1.0` |
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.1.0-rc.5` |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` |
| Surface | `web` profile |

Harness is still evolving through release candidates. This project makes a tested claim only for the version above; an untested RC may have different event, client-slot, or bundle contracts.

Download `dsh-context-lens-0.1.0.tgz` from GitHub Releases, then run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-context-lens-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh web
```

When running the CLI from a DeepSeek Harness source checkout, prefix the commands with `pnpm`:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-context-lens-0.1.0.tgz
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
pnpm dsh web
```
The dumped composition should contain a `dsh-context-lens` bundle layer and a `context-lens` row.

Pin a tag or commit instead of following a moving branch:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:OWNER/dsh-context-lens#v0.1.0
```

The repository commits the built `lib/` artifacts. pnpm 10+ may still require permission for the Git dependency's `prepare` script in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-context-lens: true
```

Grant that permission only after reviewing the pinned source. Use the release tarball when install-time builds should remain disabled.

1. Start `dsh web`.
2. Open or create a conversation and complete at least one agent turn.
3. Select **Context** beside **Chat** and **Trajectory**.
4. Choose an attempt to inspect its size, provenance, raw values, and diff from the previous attempt.
5. Use JSON export when collecting diagnostics. The export may contain reconstructed raw context, so review it before sharing.
Context Lens does not persist a second raw copy of prompts, messages, or tool schemas.

- Raw requests exist briefly in the live capture path.
- The sidecar is written under `$DSH_HOME/context-lens/v1` and contains sequence references, measurements, spans, timestamps, health, and HMACs.
- Fingerprints use HMAC-SHA-256 with a random per-install key rather than bare SHA-256.
- The local API accepts only `GET` / `HEAD`, checks the loopback peer and Host authority, and returns `Cache-Control: no-store`. Do not expose it directly to a LAN or the public internet.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `persistMetadata` | `true` | Write the metadata-only sidecar |
| `maxAttemptsPerSession` | `500` | Maximum retained attempt indexes per Session |
| `charsPerEstimatedToken` | `4` | UTF-16 code units per displayed token estimate |

Override the complete `config` in a later profile `cordis.patch.yml` layer:

```yaml
- id: context-lens
  config:
    persistMetadata: true
    maxAttemptsPerSession: 250
A DSH patch replaces the row's complete `config`; it does not deep-merge it.

1. Run `dsh --profile web --dump-config` and confirm it contains `dsh-context-lens` and `context-lens`.
2. Restart `dsh web`.
3. Hard-refresh the browser.

Capture starts after the plugin loads. Restart the Web profile, create a new conversation, and send a message. Content-free health counters are available at:

```text
/context-lens/api/v1/health
```

`recordedAttempts` should increase for real AgentLoop requests. `ignoredLlmStreams` includes auxiliary title and compaction calls and is not an error.

Move the tarball to a short path without spaces and pass that path to `dsh plugin add`. Do not use a `link:` development checkout as release compatibility evidence; release acceptance should install the packed tarball.
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-context-lens-0.1.0.tgz

dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-context-lens
```

Restart `dsh web` after updating or uninstalling. Harness leaves plugin data intact on uninstall. To remove the capture index and HMAC key as well, stop all Harness processes and delete only `$DSH_HOME/context-lens/`.

Context Lens observes named assembly around `system-prompt/assemble`, associates it with a step at `agent/pre-step`, and reads the final provider-neutral request at `llm/stream`. Every waterfall listener delegates to downstream `next()` unchanged.

Real AgentLoop requests are identified first by Harness's official `isAgentLoopRequest()` marker. If a Loader module boundary splits that process-local WeakSet, the structural proof accepts a request only when all of these conditions hold:
The plugin appends no custom Session events. Request details are reconstructed from the Harness Session and a metadata-only sidecar.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run verify
pnpm pack
```

`pnpm run verify` runs lint, TypeScript checks, the full test suite, Host/Client builds, packaging-contract tests, and release-content verification. Before releasing, install the packed tarball into a real Harness `web` profile for one complete acceptance run.

- [Plugin lifecycle](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/index.md): Host and Client entries export Cordis `apply`; required services use `inject`; registrations unload with their Fiber.
- [Plugin configuration](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/config.md): the plugin exports a Schemastery `Config`, and invalid values fail at load time.
- [Bundle publishing](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md): `package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` points to a top-level patch array, and the profile row uses the bare package name.
- [Client module table](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/client-modules.md): the Web client registers through a lazy factory and resolves platform dependencies from Harness's module table.
- [Tool authoring](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/tool.md): this plugin has no model-facing tool, so it does not use `defineTool`, a tool schema, or tool output rendering.

The runtime declarations are `package.json#dsh.bundle`, `package.json#dsh.client`, and `cordis.patch.yml`. The package does not invent a `dsh.plugin.json` manifest that the official Loader does not define.
[MIT](./LICENSE)
